Health Insurance Plans
We offer three tiers: Basic, Standard, and Premium.
Basic Plan: Covers hospitalisation up to PHP 100,000 per year. No outpatient benefit. Premium: PHP 1,200/month.
Standard Plan: Hospitalisation up to PHP 300,000/year plus outpatient consultations (up to 6 visits). Premium: PHP 2,500/month.
Premium Plan: Hospitalisation up to PHP 1,000,000/year, outpatient, dental, and vision. Premium: PHP 4,800/month.
All plans include a 30-day free-look period.

Eligibility Requirements
Applicants must be between 18 and 65 years of age at the time of application.
Pre-existing conditions are covered after a 12-month waiting period for Standard and Premium plans.
Basic plan excludes pre-existing conditions entirely.
Applicants with a BMI over 40 require additional medical underwriting.
Smokers are eligible but pay a 15% loading on the base premium.
Group plans available for companies with 5 or more employees.
Site Map | Accessibility | © 2024 ExampleInsurer

FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions
Q: How do I file a claim?
A: Submit your claim via the mobile app or call 1-800-555-0100. Claims must be filed within 60 days of the medical event.
Q: Can I add dependants?
A: Yes. Spouse and children under 21 can be added. Each dependent adds 60% of the primary member's premium.
Q: What is not covered?
A: Cosmetic procedures, experimental treatments, and self-inflicted injuries are excluded.
Q: Is there a waiting period?
A: Yes. A 30-day general waiting period applies to all plans. Pre-existing conditions: 12 months for Standard/Premium, excluded on Basic.
Q: How do I cancel?
A: Call customer service or use the app. Refunds are prorated within the 30-day free-look window.
FAQ updated: March 2024

POLICY DOCUMENT — HEALTH INSURANCE
Section 1: Definitions
Insured Person means the individual named on the certificate of insurance.
Benefit Period means one calendar year from the policy effective date.
Section 2: Hospitalisation Benefit
The insurer will reimburse reasonable and customary charges for inpatient hospital stays exceeding 24 hours. ICU stays are covered at 150% of the standard daily benefit up to the annual limit.
Section 3: Outpatient Benefit (Standard and Premium only)
Outpatient consultations with a licensed GP or specialist are reimbursed up to PHP 1,500 per visit, maximum 6 visits per benefit period for Standard, unlimited for Premium.
Section 4: Exclusions
4.1 Pre-existing conditions (see waiting period clauses).
4.2 Cosmetic or elective surgery not medically necessary.
4.3 Dental (unless Premium plan or add-on purchased).
4.4 Experimental drugs or treatments not approved by the FDA.
4.5 Injuries resulting from war, riot, or self-infliction.
Section 5: Claims Procedure
Notify insurer within 48 hours of hospitalisation. Submit documents within 60 days. Required documents: medical certificate, itemised bill, proof of payment.
Section 6: Renewal and Cancellation
Policies auto-renew annually. Premium adjustments communicated 30 days prior. Free-look cancellation within 30 days of issuance for full refund minus admin fees.

Internal Guide: Handling Common Objections
Objection: The premium is too expensive.
Response: We understand budget matters. Our Basic plan starts at PHP 1,200/month — less than PHP 40/day. It covers hospitalisation up to PHP 100,000 which can easily offset a single hospital stay.
Objection: I already have company insurance.
Response: Company plans often have gaps — they may not cover dependants fully or lapse when you leave the job. A personal plan ensures continuity.
Objection: I'm young and healthy, I don't need insurance.
Response: Most of our claims come from members aged 25–40 for accidents and sudden illnesses. The best time to lock in a low premium is when you're healthy.
Objection: I'll think about it.
Response: Absolutely, take your time. Note that premiums are age-banded so waiting increases your cost. Would it be okay to schedule a follow-up call?
Objection: I don't trust insurance companies.
Response: We're regulated by the Insurance Commission and have a claims settlement ratio of 94% in 2023.

Branch Partner Program
Operational, marketing, and technology support is provided to branch partners. Partners earn a 15% commission on first-year premiums and 5% on renewals. Training is provided quarterly. Partners must maintain a minimum sales target of 10 policies per quarter.
